text:
Brian Stewart shares personal milestones and pop culture opinions in August 2026 tweets
Ohio State Representative Brian Stewart, a Republican serving Ohio House District 12 and an Iraq War veteran, posted several personal and pop culture reflections on his Twitter account on August 12, 2026.
On the early morning of August 12, Stewart commented on recent developments in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU), writing, "The MCU (kind of) got its mojo back." Later that day, he shared a family milestone: "Lincoln’s first day as a big bad 5th grader!" In the afternoon, Stewart weighed in on casting discussions for an unspecified role, stating, "He’s the best option of those being discussed. Callum Turner looks the part but is a blank slate of charisma. Anyone who has seen SLOW HORSES understands that Lowden could be a sort of Roger Moore meets Daniel Craig blend."
Brian Stewart represents Madison and Pickaway counties and part of western Franklin County. He earned the Combat Infantryman’s Badge and two Army Commendation Medals during his service in the Iraq War. Stewart co-chaired the first meeting of the Ohio Redistricting Commission. His interests include movies, sports, target shooting, American history books, and Johnny Cash's music. Additional details about his background are available on his official website.
